# CharacterRoster

`world-system`

Several characters per player (Phase 226). The player is the account that connects; a character is who walks the world. A player keeps up to 4 characters on a server, picked from a list after choosing a world or joining a server. A new character starts from scratch: no items, base attributes, no skills, research, books or clan, and nothing from the player's other characters. Names are unique on the server across every character. Deleting a character asks for its name typed out; its structures go to its clan, or become ownerless when it had none. The character owns: characterId, body, name, hp, position, spawnPoint, statusEffects, attributes, attributeGrowth, inventory, equipment, skills, skillXp, skillFocus, digRemainder, professions, titles, cooldowns, craftCounter, research, booksLearned, tamingFlags, companions, waystones, clanMembership, ownedStructures, spawnBed. The player owns: friendCode, settings, admin, lastCharacter.

> A player can start over as someone new without losing the character they already have

## Attributes

| Field | Type | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----------- |
| ownership | json | { <field>: "character" \| "player" }: who owns each piece of per-player state |
| characterFields | json | Fields that must be the character's (a new character would otherwise inherit them) |
| playerFields | json | Fields that must be the player's |
| recordKeys | json | { <key of the pre-Phase-226 player save record>: <ownership field> }: where each key moves |
| worldKeys | json | { <world record section keyed by player id before Phase 226>: "character" }: keyed by character id after it |
| limit | integer | Characters one player may keep on one server; the host refuses one over it |
| onDelete | string | A deleted character's structures: "clan" (to its clan, ownerless without one) or "ownerless" |
| names | string | Name uniqueness scope: "server", across every character of every player |
| deleteConfirm | string | What the player types to delete a character: "name", its name, checked by the host |
| migration | string | A pre-Phase-226 save: "firstCharacter", each player's one record becomes their first character, unchanged; its id is the old player id, which the player keeps too |
| refusals | json | Locale keys the host refuses with: { limit, nameTaken, confirm, unknown, rateLimited } |

## Actions

### listCharacters

Send a player the list of their characters on this server

**Conditions:**
- The host sends the list after the player chooses a local world or joins a server: name, body, last played
- The client never decides which characters exist; it shows what the host sent

### createCharacter

Create a new character for a player through the creation screen

**Conditions:**
- Refused over the character limit (refusals.limit)
- Refused when any character on the server has the name or one that looks like it (refusals.nameTaken)
- The new character has an empty pack, base attributes, no skills, research, books, clan or structures
- Nothing is copied from the player's other characters

### playCharacter

Enter the world as one of the player's characters

**Conditions:**
- Only a character of the connecting player can be entered (refusals.unknown)
- The player's lastCharacter becomes that character

### deleteCharacter

Delete one of the player's characters

**Conditions:**
- The player types the character's name; the host compares it and refuses a mismatch (refusals.confirm)
- Its structures go to its clan, or become ownerless when it has none (onDelete)
- Its name is free again for any new character on the server

### migrateSave

Load a save written before Phase 226

**Conditions:**
- Each player record becomes that player's first character, every character field unchanged
- The first character's id is the old player id and the player keeps that id, so held names, clan membership and structure and chest owners (worldKeys) keep resolving
- The player fields move to the player; the first character is the player's lastCharacter
